call_guidance.calendar_precision: 读取meihua.calendar_policy.label_precision：官方列出2057-09-28、2089-09-04、2097-08-07朔日可能相差一日。matched_events是明示软件复核窗口，不是官方物理置信区间；保留已公布标签，不猜偏移方向、概率或替代卦。历表月日如修订须复算；未列事件不等于全时区或天文精度认证。不能删除这些日期使验收满分。
call_guidance.calendar_rules: 春节换年、民用午夜换日、闰月沿用本月数、节月季令是明示约定；不是原文唯一裁定。
call_guidance.casting: 只支持年月日時取数；输入公历钟时，按指定时区查中国农历。不得把八字立春年柱代替农历年支。
call_guidance.civil_clock: analysis_utc_offset可与analysis_timezone联合核对，格式±HH:MM或±HH:MM:SS；保留命名地区时区，不换成固定偏移。未给偏移仍拒绝重复钟时，不存在的钟时、整日跳过和错误偏移不能救回。读analysis_context.civil_utc_offset/civil_instant_utc及meihua.calendar_policy.civil_clock_resolution，核对fold、UTC和实际pytz/IANA版本。
call_guidance.day_qi: Read interpretation.day_qi for selected NLC1925 day-branch element and month/day strength.
call_guidance.external_manifestations: external_observations接收已报manifestation类别及label描述，可选填motion=moving或stationary。未知不猜，不按问题文字或未查看场景自动分类。适用于全部人事题篇（general/planning/reputation/wealth/transaction/travel/meeting/lost_property/traveler/household/dwelling/marriage/dining）。
call_guidance.first_response: 普通卦务首轮复制evidence_views.general.fields（同suggested_fields），明确选择interpretation_topic=weather时用weather卡，明确选择人事题篇时用topic卡。按实际选定的分支取证，问题文字不切换分支。需要完整JSON时使用 include=["*"]。
call_guidance.household_chapters: 显式household为家宅章、dwelling为屋舍章，均读topic/topic_details已发布字段与interpretation.topic_reading。以本候选原体为主、初用为家宅或屋舍；不是风水空间评估、房屋检查或选房迁居许可。
call_guidance.internal_control: 读取 meihua.stage_relations 与 interpretation.traditional_stage_readings（或 internal_control 字段卡）：原体加初用、体互、用互、变用共五个分析角色，分别给出本卦与互变各卦对原体的五行生克关系与 fact_path，不递归抵消、计票、加权或合成成败。
call_guidance.limits: 季令只列所选规则的旺衰，不据此生造外应或精确应期。
call_guidance.motion_context: observer_activity只接已确认占者当时seated坐/walking行/standing立，未知不补；external_observations逐条motion可为moving/stationary，未知省略，不从水土类别、label、问句、车辆运动或内卦角色推断。读interpretation.motion_context或motion字段卡。内卦体互静、用变动是符号角色；与外物运动、占者活动分列，各候选保留自身原体及外应资格路径。
call_guidance.omen_reversal: Explicitly reported external_observations manifestation gold_silver_treasure/weapon uses NLC1925內外論 original-body symbol qualifications.
call_guidance.quiet_context: observation_context只接同次起卦与占者已报label及quiet_room/nothing_heard/nothing_seen三项严格布尔，未知省略或null；未采集不等于确认无所闻见。读quiet字段卡。全真仅核对所选文明书局《静占》的不论外卦条件，不代表完整年月日衰旺合参。静室不推占者坐/行/立；问题文字和本卦动爻不补闻见事实。
call_guidance.reading: 用、体互、用互、变用均相对原体分析；经文按实际卦码与动爻引用。is_active=false为其他爻单动的假设参考。
call_guidance.reputation_supplement: reputation另读interpretation.reputation_supplement（time_class、fangdao_class及reported_context）；reputation_context只接收已确认的原文在任与職任之處条件，不从已就业、考试、问句或label推定。未知省略/null，布尔须明确。
call_guidance.situational_responses: Only when caller reports response_context for the same casting episode, use situational field card. Map querent occupied compass side, present weather, setting and human source categories against each candidate own original body.
call_guidance.solar_date_reference: 读取meihua.calendar_policy.solar_term_date_reference：对当前／下一节气和月令起终共4个锚点（compared_record_count）按固定UTC+08比较官方日标签，events保留不一致事件及实际时刻、模型、source和fact_path。date_disagreement_count按同年同名事件去重，不能把重复记录当独立验证；publisher_named_event_count是固定说明点名，日期相同不认证精度。
call_guidance.stage_emphasis: 读取interpretation.stage_emphasis或stage_emphasis字段卡。matter_scenario只接调用方已确认的原文所问事项类别：favorable_matter问吉事、unfavorable_matter问不吉之事，不是愿望、情绪、系统预测或已发生结果；未知不补，不由题篇、关键词或关系推断，天气拒绝此参数。interpretation.stage_emphasis仅在提供matter_scenario且非weather时返回，保留matter_scenario与scenario_fact_path原输入路径。
call_guidance.strength_reading: 读取 meihua.seasonal_strength（或 strength 字段卡）：按节月地支列出原体及初用、体互、用互、变用的季令旺衰（旺/衰/原文未定）与 fact_path；缺节月时 seasonal_strength 为 null，不写中性或自填旺衰，也不累加成分数。
call_guidance.topic_chapters: 显式选planning/reputation/wealth/transaction/travel/meeting/lost_property/traveler/household/dwelling并使用topic字段卡。原四章20条与新增出行/谒见10条分别保留规则集；travel另列原体旺气及各辅助生体偏好，多字阈值及舟陆等句的角色范围未裁定，不补方位或出行指令。
call_guidance.wealth_supplement: interpretation_topic=wealth 时读取 interpretation.topic_reading（求財占第十的 body、use、relation、clause_id、quote、reading），并结合 interpretation.traditional_stage_readings 与 meihua.stage_relations/seasonal_strength 解读。
call_guidance.weather: 天时占显式选interpretation_topic=weather，按需传weather字段卡或include=["interpretation.weather"]。读取interpretation.weather的ruleset_id、version、context、trigram_counts、controls（rule_id/status/affected_targets）、matched_rule_ids、pending_rule_ids，以及同级字段interpretation.comprehensive_judgement；不以体用生克判断天气，single_forecast恒为null。
call_guidance.weather_prior_context: prior_condition可用neither_prolonged表达久雨与久晴两个前期条件均已确认不成立；null或省略仍未知，不为消除pending_context而填neither。它只使四项前期条件条款not_met，不补季节、多字阈值或唯一预报。一天无雨不证明久晴，缺测或间歇天气也不自动证明两者均不成立；公开月度回顾资料不证明起卦当时已可得。
call_guidance.weather_seasonal: 秋冬春季节条文仅用已确认weather_context.season（未知不从公历月份猜），并在interpretation.weather.context与matched_rule_ids/pending_rule_ids核对实际匹配与待定状态。

civil_clock.purpose: 核对地区时区、明确偏移、实际UTC和交节比较同一时刻
civil_clock.when: 重复钟时、历史或非整小时偏移，或需要追溯时区数据；不据此断应期

day_qi.purpose: Selected day-qi, own-body and month/day qualifications; no full synthesis or reality claim
day_qi.when: Selected day-qi, own-body and month/day qualifications; no full synthesis or reality claim

external.purpose: 核对已报外应的形色／实物资格、原体及各取数候选；保留符号关系和所选原文的不同作用类别
external.when: 已确认外应类别及描述且选择人事分支；未知不补，weather不支持

external_symbol.purpose: 所报金银世宝、兵刃的原体限定与实物资格分列；不把不凶改成吉或安全
external_symbol.when: 只有已报明确类别才选新manifestation，未知省略；旧金属或锐器不自动升级为新类别

general.purpose: 首轮读取本互变、实际动爻经文及原体用生克。
general.when: interpretation_topic=general（默认）。明确选天时占用weather，明确选人事题篇用topic。

motion.description: 占者坐行立、实际外应动静与内卦符号角色分列；缺吉凶判断的条件保持待定，无日期或结局

obstruction_days.description: 生克并见时的条件化原文计日；明例与类推、实际角色、制约与候选分别保留，非净延迟或现实日期

quiet.purpose: 静占已报条件与未知状态、内卦资料范围；不把未采集解释为无外应
quiet.when: 人事分支需要区别未采集与当次静室无所闻见声明时；不套天时占

reading.purpose: 读同一次时间梅花的卦变、原体下初中终生克与季令，区分原文和现代建议

rules_and_calendar.purpose: 核对原文修订、历法约定与实际取数过程；不另起卦

situational.purpose: 已报同次方应、天时应、地理应、人事应与原体符号关系；多候选及异文分列
situational.when: 仅在已提供response_context时读取；未知现场资料省略，常规reading保留原输出；不用于天时预测分支

solar_date_reference.purpose: 核对实际交节时刻与固定UTC+08公布日期，包含月令起终锚点；保留差异与未比较项
solar_date_reference.when: 历表与计算日期不一致、官方点名近午夜或需追溯月令依据；不另起卦

stage_emphasis.description: 所报原文问事情境、内卦紧次及迟速／生克条件

stage_emphasis_details.description: 所报原文问事情境、内卦紧次及迟速／生克条件

topic.purpose: 核对所选文明书局本八章的初始体用条款及出行偏好、失物方位类象、行人初用参照、异文与各实际取数候选；不以通用吉凶取代章句

topic_details.purpose: 完整所选题篇条款、异文及实际候选的原体用/互变/季令与爻辞参照
topic_details.when: 显式题篇分支需要完整细节时；沿用同run参数或 include

trigram_symbols.purpose: 核对本次原体与初用、体互、用互、变用的卦名、五行生克关系及季令旺衰，保留各角色 fact_path；不能推定现实人物、姓氏、方位、灾祸、诊疗或应期。
trigram_symbols.when: 比较体用及互变各卦名、五行生克关系与季令旺衰时（含默认 general 与各人事分支；天时分支 seasonal_strength 按季节参数核对）

wealth.purpose: 核对所选求财初始条款与补充句关系成分、各候选及制约，保留并存关系
wealth.when: interpretation_topic=wealth；不按问题文字自动切换

weather.purpose: 先读实际命中条文、制约资格、五/六位置计数差异及旧研究负结果；不以体用判晴雨，不把raw matched当成未受制天气断言
weather.when: interpretation_topic=weather时选择；需要的weather_context由已确认事实提供

weather_details.purpose: 完整天气规则、计数、条件轨迹与来源；用于核对缺项和跨章制化候选
weather_details.when: interpretation_topic=weather且需要完整细节时；沿用同run参数或 include

label.description: Caller description/reference for this reported observation; presence and classification are not independently verified
label.title: Label

manifestation.description: Caller-reported selected source category; gold_silver_treasure and weapon are explicit NLC1925內外論 classifications, never inferred from every metallic ornament or sharp tool, free text, favorable/unfavorable wishes or an unseen scene. Symbolic body qualification is separate from material effect, real-world safety and outcomes. Unknown manifestations cannot be guessed
manifestation.title: Manifestation

motion.description: Optional caller-reported actual motion of this external observation. Omit if unknown; never inferred from material, description, observer activity or inner symbolic roles. Moving water/carried soil and still wells/ground remain distinct. Does not determine omen valence or an event date
motion.title: Motion

orientation.description: Caller-reported movement toward or away from the observer at the same instant, for 卷二·向背. Separate from motion and compass direction. Omit if unknown.
orientation.title: Orientation

label.description: Caller reference for the same casting episode and observer. Not parsed to infer any condition; presence or perception is not independently verified
label.title: Label

nothing_heard.description: Caller declaration of no external 所闻 in the selected 静占 sense at this cast; omit/null if unknown. No inference from absent records or unimplemented categories
nothing_heard.title: Nothing Heard

nothing_seen.description: Caller declaration of no external 所见 in the selected 静占 sense at this cast; omit/null if unknown. No inference from an unseen scene, empty records or unimplemented categories
nothing_seen.title: Nothing Seen

quiet_room.description: Caller declaration of 在静室 for this cast; omit/null if unknown. Physical setting is not mental stillness or a decibel measurement
quiet_room.title: Quiet Room

direction.description: Reported compass side occupied by the person asking at this cast; not movement heading, facing, address or the casting object's direction. No compass bearing or north-reference conversion inferred
direction.title: Direction

reference_label.description: Caller-reported reference/origin for this occupied side; not parsed or independently located
reference_label.title: Reference Label

currently_in_office.description: Caller-confirmed 在任 in the selected historical official-office clause, not generic modern employment, seniority or a desired promotion. Omit/null if unknown; no real personnel or hazard verdict follows
currently_in_office.title: Currently In Office

label.description: Caller reference for the declared source context; never parsed to infer office status, desired result or an appointment
label.title: Label

seeking_official_appointment.description: Caller confirms the question concerns the source's 職任之處. Not inferred from reputation, an exam, already being employed, question keywords or wishes. Omit/null if unknown; selected 方道 witnesses are not an actual location
seeking_official_appointment.title: Seeking Official Appointment

human.description: Caller-reported source classes 老人/老婦/少男/少女 or actually heard笑語/encountered哭泣. No numerical age cutoffs, automatic person classification or outcomes. Laughter/weeping do not manufacture a trigram
human.title: Human

same_casting_episode_confirmed.description: Caller explicitly confirms these are reported actual conditions at this casting episode, not desired/future outcomes. Presence/classification is not independently verified
same_casting_episode_confirmed.title: Same Casting Episode Confirmed

setting.description: Reported place at the cast: 竹林/江河溪澗池沼/五金/窰竈爐火/土瓦. Keep all source trigram candidates; never infer setting from address, objects, question or unseen scene
setting.title: Setting

weather.description: Reported present conditions corresponding to 晴明/雨/雪/雨雪未分/風/雷. 雨雪皆配坎, but坎體宜雨does not uniquely establish a preference for snow; rain_or_snow keeps that condition pending. Human-matter 天時應 only; not a future weather prediction or daily rain label. Unknown omit/null; multiple observations retained without voting
weather.title: Weather

many_min_count.description: Declared software threshold for 多, with both six-position and five-role static-once scope probes retained. The raw six-position status is qualified when scopes disagree; neither scope is claimed as uniquely classical. If absent, potentially applicable 多 conditions remain pending
many_min_count.title: Many Min Count

prior_condition.description: Caller-confirmed prior weather: prolonged_rain, prolonged_clear, or neither_prolonged only when both prolonged conditions are confirmed false. None means unknown, never confirmed neither. The original gives no number of days for 久. No rainfall alone does not establish clear sky; a completed dry day, a missing observation or a cast cannot supply this fact
prior_condition.title: Prior Condition

season.description: Confirmed season in the source's weather context; not inferred from a timezone or Gregorian month
season.title: Season

input.description: Request model for time-seeded Mei Hua Yi Shu analysis.

analysis_longitude.description: Optional longitude in decimal degrees; required when use_true_solar_time is True.
analysis_longitude.title: Analysis Longitude

analysis_minute.description: Confirmed civil minute (strict integer 0-59), when known. Omitted/null means unavailable; numerical00 is only the nominal calculation reference, not a claim that the event occurred on the hour. No rounding or measurement-error interval is inferred. Minute and second never add to the cast seed.
analysis_minute.title: Analysis Minute

analysis_place.description: 起卦地点名称（支持离线地名库自动补全 analysis_longitude / analysis_timezone）
analysis_place.title: Analysis Place

analysis_second.description: Optional civil second (0-59), only when known; preserves the instant for solar-term boundaries, never an additional cast seed. Omitted/null keeps the existing minute anchored at second 00. Input precision does not certify clock or ephemeris accuracy; leap-second label 60 is unsupported.
analysis_second.title: Analysis Second

analysis_timezone.description: Civil-clock timezone (IANA or UTC offset; defaults to Asia/Shanghai). Keep the named zone when using analysis_utc_offset to select a repeated clock. Nonexistent clocks remain invalid. A regional rule whose selected local time is unspecified cannot be treated as UTC; use a confirmed fixed offset as analysis_timezone when available.
analysis_timezone.title: Analysis Timezone

analysis_utc_offset.description: Optional explicit UTC offset, ±HH:MM or ±HH:MM:SS. Verified jointly with analysis_timezone at the supplied local clock; selects a fold without replacing the named calendar zone. Cannot rescue a DST gap or skipped date. Omit to keep rejecting ambiguous clocks. An offset cannot certify an unspecified regional time type; a confirmed fixed offset belongs in analysis_timezone.
analysis_utc_offset.title: Analysis Utc Offset

analysis_year.description: Gregorian analysis year; supported civil dates: 1900-01-01 to 2100-12-31
analysis_year.title: Analysis Year

external_observations.description: Optional caller-reported manifestations for general/planning/reputation/wealth/transaction/travel/meeting/lost_property/traveler/household/dwelling/marriage/dining; NLC1925 selected material-versus-appearance qualifications plus explicit gold_silver_treasure/weapon original-body symbolic cases. Traveler observations keep the original-body reference and are not automatically rebased to initial use. Omit if unknown; max 12 items.
external_observations.title: External Observations

interpretation_topic.description: Explicit branch: general; weather (no body/use); planning/reputation/wealth/transaction (文明书局本原四章初始体用条款，wealth另列求财成分)；travel/meeting为同本出行/谒见章，travel另核旺气及辅助生体偏好，多字及舟陆角色范围未裁定；lost_property为失物章五种初始关系及明示变用经卦读法的方位类象。traveler为行人章，返归句保留原体参照，在外补充明示以初用为受生受克对象，四个其他内卦角色逐一列出；初用月令衰与受克须同时成立，未知不猜，多字门槛及完整角色范围未裁定。reputation另列求名补充句及原文時序/方道，reputation_context声明原文在任与求职任条件，未知不猜，巽方道東/同本地理及转录東南等差异未裁定。household/dwelling分别为家宅/屋舍章，沿用实际原体与初用。家宅比利/转录比和未裁定，五行相同不自动套家宅安稳句；屋舍保留冷退/衰退异文。家宅生体转引人事章只核所列四内卦实际角色，未作完整跨章合参。marriage为婚姻章五种初始关系，并分别核原体所占之家、初用所婚之家的已报节月旺气条件；原文未定与缺月令保持未知。补充生体/体生只列实际关系成分，或字不合并成必然同现；后段比利/转录比和未裁定，不自动套彼此相就句；八卦相貌品行按原文条文保留。dining为飲食章五种初始关系，并另列内卦坎酒、兑食及體用類的坤艮制坎、离制兑；这些句不要求多字门槛，不因制约者受制或季令衰自动抵消，完整内外合参未裁定；影印生身/转录生体及兑坎组合未裁定，版本异文另列。Question keywords never switch branches.
interpretation_topic.title: Interpretation Topic

matter_scenario.description: Caller-confirmed subject category for the selected 占卦訣: 原文问吉事 or 原文问不吉之事. Not a desired answer, question sentiment, or topic classification. Omit when unknown. Human-matter branches only
matter_scenario.title: Matter Scenario

observation_context.description: Optional same-cast/observer quiet-room and hearing/vision declarations for human branches. Missing is uncollected, not confirmed absent. Selected NLC1925静占 conditions only; no full year-month-day strength synthesis. Never changes old study denominators

observer_activity.description: Optional caller-confirmed observer activity corresponding to selected NLC1925 我坐/我行/我立. Omit if unknown; no inference from question or external movement. Selected relative wording only. Human-matter branches only
observer_activity.title: Observer Activity

question.description: Question or topic for the divination context
question.title: Question

reputation_context.description: Optional caller-confirmed 在任 and 職任之處 declarations, only with interpretation_topic=reputation. Unknown omit/null; no keyword inference.

response_context.description: Optional caller-reported same-cast 方應/天時應/地理應/人事應 for human matters. No scene, direction or weather inferred; retain multiple trigram candidates and source variants. Not a casting method or combined ten-response verdict.

use_true_solar_time.description: Apply true solar time correction before resolving the lunar cast hour (default False).
use_true_solar_time.title: Use True Solar Time

weather_context.description: Optional caller-confirmed season and weather declarations, only with interpretation_topic=weather. Omit unknown facts; these conditions qualify the selected classical weather clauses.

input.title: MeihuaAnalysisRequest
